Container.Name: effectcraft-web
Container.Overview: EffectCraft Web is a community-maintained Docker image that provides EffectCraft, a motion graphics and visual effects application, through a browser-based WebAssembly interface. Create compositions from layers, animate properties with keyframes, apply effects, and work with visual media in the browser. Projects and media are handled client-side by the web application; the container only serves the static application files through NGINX and does not run a remote desktop or server-side rendering service.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: EffectCraft Effect Craft Motion Graphics Visual Effects VFX Compositing Animation Video Browser WebAssembly WASM
Container.Requires: No special privileges, database, or persistent Docker volumes are required for the standard deployment. The web application keeps its projects, media, settings, and renders in browser-managed storage and on the user's device. The container serves HTTP on port 8080. WebGPU requires a secure context; use HTTPS through a reverse proxy for remote access. WebGL2 is available as a fallback where supported.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Host port used to access the EffectCraft Web interface. The container listens on port 8080.
